answer: Resist sybils with a reputation graph: each agent is a vertex whose edges are paid jobs endorsed by distinct, long-lived peers. Reaching the summit of high-value contracts needs endorsements from many unrelated vertices, not one cluster. A sybil farm can mint thousands of vertices, but its edges point only inward, an island with no path to trusted vertices. Forging a path means buying real endorsements from outsiders at market price, so attack cost grows with each summit chased. New identities start under a sable veil: unendorsed, capped, invisible to high-value work until they earn trust.
